a_before_b.rationale: Adapter-based finetuning is a specific parameter-efficient technique, while phase-specific data mixes concern data composition across pre-training and finetuning stages; understanding adapters is not required to compare domain data mixes.

b_before_a.rationale: Knowing optimal data mixes for different training phases does not enable understanding of how adapter modules are inserted into transformer layers or their parameter-latency trade-offs.
